description: Parse a github.com URL (repo, pull request, issue, commit, file, directory, or release tag) into structured components, including an optional #L10-L20 line-range anchor for file URLs. SSH remotes and other Git hosts are out of scope.

url.description: The github.com URL to parse, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

name: parse_github_url
